extra.evidence: card set "Angel of Mercy" refers to name = 'Angel of Mercy'; appear on Magic: The Gathering Online refers to mtgoCode is NOT NULL and vice versa

extra.SQL: SELECT IIF(T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL, 'YES', 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T1.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
